notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
At least two cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Immortal Coil by tapping it and exiling two cards from your graveyard, drawing a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Immortal Coil.
Repeat the previous two steps until your graveyard is empty.
Immortal Coil's last ability triggers.
In response, activate Elite Arcanist by paying {4} and tapping it, casting and resolving a copy of Stunning Reversal without paying its mana cost.
Let the Immortal Coil trigger resolve, drawing seven cards and setting your life total to 1.
Immortal Coil's last ability triggers again.
In response, activate Mind Over Matter five times by discarding five cards, untapping Elite Arcanist and four lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {4}.
Let the Immortal Coil trigger resolve, drawing seven cards and setting your life total to 1.
Repeat until there are no cards in your library, activating Mind Over Matter by discarding a card additional times at any point if needed to adjust your library size and avoid drawing from an empty library.
